Title: [LSJ] Which action cannot be performed more than once per turn ?

Messages.Author: franck
Messages.Body:
Is there only bleed actions and Card actions which cannot be performed more
than once per turn ?

Say, if i play an Ambush, then Freak drive can i play a Bum's Rush ?

Assuming Francois Villon could by any means untap once each turn, could he
uses his blood stealing capacity twice in the current turn ?

One more example to be sure :p

If one of my Ravnos is equipped with an Eye of Hazimel, can i use the rush
ability of it as many times as i have Freak drives in hand (and survive all
fights ;) ?

Thanks,
Francisco from France

>Is there only bleed actions and Card actions which cannot be performed more
>than once per turn ?

and political actions. and you need to define card actions as 'action
card or card in play'

>Say, if i play an Ambush, then Freak drive can i play a Bum's Rush ?

yes. they are different cards.

>Assuming Francois Villon could by any means untap once each turn, could he
>uses his blood stealing capacity twice in the current turn ?

no. Francois is a card in play.

>One more example to be sure :p
>
>If one of my Ravnos is equipped with an Eye of Hazimel, can i use the rush
>ability of it as many times as i have Freak drives in hand (and survive all
>fights ;) ?

no. Eye of Hazimel is a card in play. You could however Eye of Hazimel
attack, freak drive, Ambush, freak drive, Bum's Rush, freak drive,
Harass, freak drive, etc...
'attack a minion' is not a bleed or a political action, so is only
limited to not repeating by the cards used to enter combat.

from the obscure zone of hidden knowledge known as The Rulebook (Cam
ed.).......

6.1.1 Bleed
...
A minion cannot perform more than one bleed
action each turn, even if he untaps.

6.1.6 Action Card (or Card in Play)
...
A minion cannot perform an action with the same action
card or via the same card in play (including from the minion’s
own card text) more than once each turn, even if he untaps.

6.1.7 Political Action (+1 stealth)
...
A minion cannot
perform more than one political action each turn.

does that answer the questions? :)

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 19 May 2003 05:04:02 +0200, "franck" <f.fe...@wanadoo.fr>

wrote:

>Is there only bleed actions and Card actions which cannot be performed more
>than once per turn ?

Vote.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

6.1.1

A minion cannot perform more than one bleed action each turn, even if
he untaps.

6.1.6

A minion cannot perform an action with the same action card or via the
same card in play (including from the minion's own card text) more
than once each turn, even if he untaps.

6.1.7

A minion cannot perform more than one political action each turn.

>Say, if i play an Ambush, then Freak drive can i play a Bum's Rush ?

Absolutely.

>Assuming Francois Villon could by any means untap once each turn, could he
>uses his blood stealing capacity twice in the current turn ?

No.
This is an action granted by a card in play (Francois himself), so it
cannot be repeated on the same turn.

>One more example to be sure :p

>If one of my Ravnos is equipped with an Eye of Hazimel, can i use the rush
>ability of it as many times as i have Freak drives in hand (and survive all
>fights ;) ?

No.
The rush action is granted by a card in play, so it cannot be repeated
on the same turn.

See also the FAQ, section 3.19

http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_faq.htm

3.19 What is the "NRA" or "No Repeat Actions" rule?

The NRA or "No Repeat Actions rule" was a rule instituted by the
Vampire: Elder Kindred Network for tournament play with constructed
decks (ie non-draft non-sealed tournaments). It has since become a
part of the base rules for the game.

The new base rules incorporate a variation of the No Repeat Actions
special floor rule from the V:EKN tournament rules. Instead of
restricting repeats by (a sometimes difficult to define) type, a
minion cannot

bleed twice in a turn
take a political action twice in a turn
use the same action card twice in a turn
take the action allowed by a card in play twice in a turn
by the new rules, with no restrictions on, for example, hunting or
equipping (assuming the minion can untap, of course). The last item
(card in play) includes any special ability the minion may have.

As equipment cards (and retainers, and allies) all count as action
cards, you may take multiple equip minion actions with the same minion
on any given turn, but they cannot be the same piece of equipment.
You can: Equip with a Sport Bike, Untap, Equip with a .44 Magnum.
You cannot: Equip with a .44 Magnum, Untap, Equip with a second .44
Magnum.

An action is only considered to have been taken if it resolves by
either being blocked or by being successful.

A minion that initiates an action but that action is taken over by
another with Mask of a Thousand Faces is not considered to have taken
that action and is not prohibited from taking that action later in the
turn.

An action that is cancelled by Direct Intervention on the card used to
begin the action is not considered to have been taken, but the card is
considered to have been played. A minion may immediately take the same
action or same type of action even though the Direct Intervention was
played with the NRA rule.

Example 1: A vampire who bleeds his controller's prey via Computer
Hacking, then untaps via Freak Drive, cannot perform any bleeding
action again, of any kind whatsoever, in that same turn.
Example 2: A vampire who takes a Govern the Unaligned action at
superior to move 3 blood to an uncontrolled vampire, then untaps via
Freak Drive, may not use another Govern the Unaligned card to bleed
that turn. That vampire may bleed with any other card or without a
card, just not with Govern the Unaligned.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra
